name: reply-in-thread
description: Replies in a Slack message thread, optionally also showing the reply in the channel. Takes the channel by name or id (list-channels lists them) and the thread's parent message's ts: a message's own ts from read-channel-history or post-message, or its thread ts when it is itself a reply.

channel.description: A channel name, with or without the leading #, or a channel id from list-channels.

threadTs.description: The ts of the thread's parent message: from read-channel-history or post-message, or the first message read-thread answers. For a message that is itself a reply, its thread ts, never its own ts.

text.description: The reply text in Slack mrkdwn.

alsoSendToChannel.description: Also show the reply in the channel. Defaults to false.
